purpose: A dated manual reread of official Thunderpick Match Winner pages for the 18 October TWC 2026 final day. Research only; neither fixture was a Hotspawn board pick at the observation time.
capture_method: Arena fetch_page rendered-page text retrieval; the official Match Winner selection and both displayed prices were visible. No raw HTTP response, operator quote-update timestamp, market depth/liquidity, or trade timestamp was exposed by this capture. The conservative observation timestamp is the retrieval-window start, not a Thunderpick server timestamp.

limitations: Only one bookmaker's displayed two-way Match Winner prices are recorded. The re-read did not recheck Pinnacle, Polymarket, or other operators, and it does not establish market consensus.

The page-text read exposed no server-side odds update timestamp or market depth. The observation time is the bounded retrieval time recorded above; prices may change before each match and expire at 08:54:12 UTC.

Neither TWC fixture was in the Hotspawn CS2 board inventory at the latest published observation (18 October 00:28 UTC). These are research-only final-day guide prices, not submitted Hotspawn picks or scoreable board rows.

The earlier 17 October tournament-card versus market-page difference is retained as a historical discrepancy. This session did not reread the tournament card and does not assert that the discrepancy is still present or that the new line is a confirmed market move.
